description:
Bota brings your offscreen conversations into ChatGPT. Bota devices capture in-person meetings, calls, and conversations, and this plugin gives ChatGPT secure, read-only access to the transcripts and audio in your Bota account.

Ask ChatGPT to find what was said in a past meeting, pull up a specific recording, or list your recent recordings. Then turn those transcripts into summaries, action items, follow-up emails, or notes, all in the chat you already use.

Sign in with your Bota account to connect. The plugin only reads your own recordings; it never edits, deletes, or shares them.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my latest recording and list the action items
What did we decide about pricing in last week's meetings?
Draft a follow-up email from my call with the client today
